convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for FrAMACandle custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position open/close logic and money management

other_exits: Signal-based close: BUY_Close triggered when TrendValue[1]==0 (downtrend signal), SELL_Close triggered when TrendValue[1]==2 (uptrend signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lots, BALANCE=percentage of balance, FREEMARGIN=percentage of free margin, LOSSFREEMARGIN=percentage of free margin minus floating loss, LOSSBALANCE=percentage of balance minus floating loss

custom_logic_notes: FrAMACandle buffer 4 provides TrendValue: 0=downtrend, 1=neutral, 2=uptrend. Long entry requires TrendValue[1]==2 AND TrendValue[0]<2 (trend just turned bullish). Short entry requires TrendValue[1]==0 AND TrendValue[0]>0 (trend just turned bearish). Signal timing uses SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec (next bar open time). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates controlling which signals are acted on. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit. When SignalBar==0, signals are recalculated every tick without new-bar guard.
python_conversion_notes: FrAMACandle is a custom indicator that must be replicated in Python - need to find its source to extract the FrAMA (Fractal Adaptive Moving Average) algorithm. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/Close wrappers with 5 money management modes and must be reimplemented. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) not pips - need digit-adjustment awareness. The entry logic uses a trend-state transition (value changes from non-2 to 2 for longs, non-0 to 0 for shorts) which is a crossover-like condition on the discrete trend state. Signal time is calculated as next bar open for order timestamping.
